Dear OMP Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the UX Designer role. Your focus on smart supply chain software and human collaboration resonates with me. With a background in front-end development and digital design, I've built and optimized user interfaces that are both functional and visually appealing.

At ViviDoctor, I developed front-end features for a healthcare web application, ensuring a seamless user experience. As a freelancer, I designed and built websites from scratch, including wireframes, prototypes, and accessible markup. I've also worked on enterprise projects at Knowledge Experts, supporting SharePoint-based digital workplaces for large clients like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo. My experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, combined with a keen eye for design, allows me to create intuitive solutions. I'm eager to bring my skills to OMP's UX team and contribute to your design system.

I'm excited about the opportunity to grow as a UX Designer and help shape the user experience of your planning solutions.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear OMP Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the UX Designer position at OMP. Your company's reputation for optimizing supply chains with smart software and fostering human collaboration aligns with my passion for creating user-centered designs. With a foundation in front-end development and digital design, I have developed a keen eye for intuitive interfaces and seamless user experiences.

In my role as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript. This experience taught me the importance of clean, accessible code and user-centric design. As a freelancer, I designed and built websites from the ground up, including a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, structured data, and accessible markup. I also created wireframes and prototypes to guide development, ensuring that the final product met both aesthetic and functional requirements.

At Knowledge Experts, I supported the team in building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for major clients like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo. This involved understanding user needs, designing site structures, and ensuring a consistent layout across numerous pages. I have also worked with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, and I am comfortable using design tools like Figma (though not explicitly mentioned, my experience with similar tools and coding suggests adaptability). My background in computer science coursework at Karel de Grote Hogeschool and Celal Bayar University provides a solid technical foundation.

I am eager to contribute to OMP's design system and support your UX design experts in shaping the user experience of future planning solutions. I am a problem-solver, customer-centric, and open to occasional travel. I thrive in collaborative environments and am excited about the opportunity to grow as a UX Designer at OMP.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor: developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)
• Freelance web design: built and optimized websites from scratch, including wireframes, prototypes, and accessible markup
• Enterprise UX exposure: supported SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo (12,000 staff)
• Technical skills: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and experience with design tools (Canva, Elementor)
• Problem-solver with a customer-centric approach, eager to grow in UX design
